text: Maakan -an yo Nulaaɗo- ɓee sirkooɓe: Noddee -Ko onon yo sirkooɓe- ɓen ɓe aaƴiɗon ko reweteeɓe gaanin Alla si lorra jippike e mon, kamɓe ɓe maraa feere duncugol lorra kan e mon, ɓe maraa kadi feere egginngol lorra kan faande e tanaa mon sabu ronkere maɓɓe, on laatiiɗo ko o ronkuɗo o wonataa reweteeɗo.
